entities.summary: The Universidad Autónoma de Asunción is a private university in Asunción, Paraguay. It was founded in 1978 as the Escuela Superior de Administración de Empresas ; it obtained its title of university in 1991. As of 2006, it has 5000 students and 350 professors.
